tei:div.tei:p: gro lod kyi gsol 'debs dngos grub snye ma bzhugs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐: nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams nas// chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid rtogs pas bdag rgyud 'ching ba grol// thugs rjes gzhan sgrol nus par byin gyis rlobs// shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i pho brang nas// longs sku thugs rje (2)chen po la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid rtogs pas bdag rgyud 'ching ba grol// thugs rjes gzhan sgrol nus par byin gyis rlobs/lho nub pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams nas// sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid rtogs pas bdag rgyud 'ching ba grol// thugs rjes gzhan sgrol nus par byin gyis rlobs// mon kha stag tshang bsam 'grub gnas mchog nas// dpal chen rdo rje gro lod la gsol ba 'debs/ stong nyid rtogs pas bdag rgyud 'ching ba grol// thugs rjes gzhan sgrol nus par byin gyis rlobs// zla gam dmar (3)smug dbang gi pho brang na// rta mgrin dbang gi lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid rtogs pasabadag rgyud 'ching ba grol// thugs rjes gzhan sgrol nus par byin gyis rlobs// ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang gzhal yas na// ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid rtogs pas bdag rgyud 'ching ba grol// thugs rjes gzhan sgrol nus par byin gyis rlobs// bsam yas dbu rtse (4)rigs gsum pho brang na// lha lcam pad+ma gsal la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid rtogs pas bdag rgyud 'ching ba grol// thugs rjes gzhan sgrol nus par byin gyis rlobs// sna tshogs ma nges gdul bya'i zhing khams na// rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid rtogs pas bdag rgyud 'ching ba grol// thugs rjes gzhan sgrol nus par byin gyis rlobs// snying nas gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// brgyud gsum rtsal 'chang (5)rig pa 'dzin pa dang*// dbang chen khros pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes gzi byin gyis// ma dag snang zhen sgyu ma'i lha skur dag

/rlung sngags dbyer med sngags kyi ngo bor grub// dran rtogs 'od gsal chos kyi skur smin nas// mi slob zung 'jug 'bras bu'i go 'phang brnyes// drang srong dmod pa rdo rje'i mtshon char gyis// ma rungs bdud sde phye mar brlag byas te// byang chub sgrub pa mtha' (6)ru phyin par shog / ces pa'ang sdom brtson ldan pa bla ma nor li'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o// ////////////////////////////////////
